topics.name: LLM agent workflow orchestration
topics.summary: These systems improve extended agent work by refining harnesses, coordinating multiple workers, and learning from execution traces or reward attribution. Benchmarks span research tasks, software and science workflows, with gains coming from better information flow, task decomposition, and recovery rather than simply longer responses.

topics.name: Agent skill retrieval and tool infrastructure
topics.summary: Agent ecosystems are treated as catalogs and infrastructure: skills are consolidated, retrieved, and routed through tool gateways or shared services. Evaluations emphasize compatibility, context cost, multi-tenant isolation, and dependable access to reusable procedures.

topics.name: Runtime safety and governance for AI agents
topics.summary: Runtime monitors, world-model forecasts, memory checks, policy tests, and forensic privacy analyses constrain autonomous behavior before errors spread. Governance studies add lifecycle controls, fairness review, risk thresholds, and human escalation across GUI, dialogue, and deployed systems.

topics.name: Interactive agent clarification and state tracking
topics.summary: Dialogue-state tracking, clarification policies, and long-horizon memory audits help agents recover intent and preserve entity bindings. Results show that targeted re-verification and failure-aware questioning reduce drift, though ambiguity remains difficult under changing context.

topics.name: Structured agents for technical workflows
topics.summary: Schema-driven agents connect language models to formal ontologies, theorem provers, and hardware-validation tools. Intermediate representations and explicit subgoals make reasoning traceable and reduce brittle tool calls in technical tasks.

topics.name: Evaluation of LLM reasoning and capabilities
topics.summary: Capability studies combine process traces, expert rubrics, perturbation tests, and learnability analyses to distinguish genuine reasoning from fluent output. Findings recur around recovery behavior, analytical weaknesses, unstable capabilities, and the limits of static benchmark scores.

topics.name: Mechanistic interpretability and representation dynamics
topics.summary: Layer probes, activation readouts, mechanistic transformer analyses, recurrent dynamics, and neural-activity datasets trace how representations form and change. Across language, vision, and graph-like computation, internal signals explain relevance, copying, forgetting, and structured latent organization.

topics.name: LLM post-training and decoding
topics.summary: Post-training methods range from compact adapters and prompt rewriting to specialist merging, diffusion-language decoding, optimizer changes, and verifiable rewards. Results tie improvement to update geometry, exploration, and correction placement, while keeping base-model changes small.

topics.name: Language representation and contextual semantics
topics.summary: Token, byte, pixel, positional, cross-lingual, and context-sensitive encodings are compared on multilingual semantics, dialogue, sarcasm, and NLI-like judgments. The recurring lesson is that language- and task-specific structure improves transfer, but formal cues do not fully predict human disagreement.

topics.name: Document intelligence and auditable retrieval
topics.summary: Document and retrieval systems combine visual or metadata cues, source search, temporal validity, evidence identifiers, and forgery checks. Tests on scientific, legal, Chinese-search, and biomedical material favor traceable extraction and freshness-aware support over unsupported generation.

topics.name: Vision-language model reliability and adaptation
topics.summary: Vision-language evaluations cover fingerprint verification, grounding, class imbalance, remote sensing, and repeated visual inspection. Prompt format, privileged distillation, adaptive priors, and task-aware updates affect failure modes as much as model scale, especially under distribution shift.

topics.name: Scientific multimodal reasoning and visualization
topics.summary: Scientific multimodal systems align charts, tables, geospatial imagery, symbolic evidence, and domain language through tool use, specialized tokens, and broad instruction data. Applications span visual claim checking, scientific discovery workbenches, and foundation models, with transfer depending on structured evidence handling.

topics.name: Human-centered and affective AI interaction
topics.summary: User studies and interactive agents examine trust, perceived minds, affective dialogue, ethical reflection, and technology visions from justice-impacted communities. Timing, personalization, stakeholder participation, and deliberate friction shape autonomy and responsibility more reliably than persuasive explanations alone.

topics.name: AI-assisted writing and spoken-language assessment
topics.summary: Classroom feedback studies and spoken-proficiency models measure how AI assistance changes writing practice and scoring reliability. Learners value rapid suggestions but can overdepend on them, while acoustic and transcript shortcuts require leakage-resistant objectives.

topics.name: EEG studies of language and cognition
topics.summary: EEG and BCI studies relate surprisal, lexical category, electrode bandwidth, and model alignment to millisecond neural responses. Results vary with word type and measurement choice, showing that larger language models or more sensors do not automatically produce more human-like signals.

topics.name: Sequential recommendation systems
topics.summary: Sequence models and streaming profiles represent persistent interests, semantic intent, and fast-changing preferences for ranking short videos and other content. Compression, memory, and feedback updates seek online gains without making serving or profile maintenance too expensive.

topics.name: Medical image analysis and clinical vision
topics.summary: Clinical vision work spans CT adaptation, MRI fusion, lesion-focused modeling, parameter-efficient expert composition, and anatomical segmentation. Evaluations under scanner or domain shift show that preserving modality-specific structure and routing to suitable specialists matters more than a generic encoder alone.

topics.name: Remote sensing and environmental mapping
topics.summary: Remote and environmental mapping systems fuse spectral, thermal, depth, morphological, census, and geospatial cues for fire, terrain, water, and socioeconomic estimation. Lightweight attention and regularized downscaling improve transfer across terrain, atmosphere, and geographic scale.

topics.name: Industrial vision and process monitoring
topics.summary: Industrial vision models monitor welding dynamics, semiconductor bottlenecks, spectral materials, and RTL timing using latent state models, spectral-spatial features, and learned surrogates. Real process logs and cross-dataset tests emphasize robustness to disturbances, rework, and limited labels.

topics.name: Low-light and biometric vision
topics.summary: Low-light enhancement, infrared target separation, and palm-vein recognition rely on Retinex-style restoration, signal-preserving constraints, and cross-sensor feature matching. The shared goal is stable identity or detection when contrast is weak and targets are tightly spaced.

topics.name: Controllable diffusion and visual generation
topics.summary: Diffusion systems add physical variables, layouts, relation-aware experts, reuse of attention state, or continuous representations to control images and multimodal content. Flood scenarios, knowledge-graph completion, style transfer, and object placement show that explicit structure improves fidelity and reduces sampling cost.

topics.name: Long-video understanding and efficient inference
topics.summary: Long-video models allocate attention with frame selection, tree search, recovery actions, audio-visual fusion, and load-balanced sparse execution. Benchmarks for evidence localization and complex clips show better budget use when global context is retained while detail follows the query.

topics.name: Long-horizon video generation
topics.summary: Long-form video generators address drift with camera-aware geometry, persistent character memories, noise-consistency steering, and coarse-to-fine temporal prediction. Viewpoint changes, scene transitions, and extended rollouts remain the stress tests for identity and motion continuity.

topics.name: Physics-grounded video synthesis
topics.summary: Physics-aware video systems use simulation, reflective program repair, and staged mechanics benchmarks to connect visual generation with physical rules. Results expose separate weaknesses in perception, law selection, and carrying several constraints across time.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction and event-based vision
topics.summary: Gaussian splatting, event streams, stereo geometry, SLAM, and semantic communication are combined with equivariant embeddings, variational updates, epipolar cues, and cross-modal reconstruction. The methods target real-time mapping, motion recovery, and lower communication or data-movement cost.

topics.name: Human motion understanding and teleoperation
topics.summary: Egocentric and exocentric cameras support future pose forecasting, whole-body teleoperation, text-to-motion control, and human-object trajectory prediction. Hierarchical features, cross-view supervision, and action units improve robustness to occlusion and make demonstrations more useful for robots.

topics.name: Active and domain-aware embodied perception
topics.summary: Active exploration, spatial inconsistency, animal re-identification, weed or food grounding, and other domain-specific tasks guide sensing toward uncertain regions. Geometry, anomaly scores, and specialized supervision improve detection or annotation efficiency, but transfer to new scenes remains fragile.

topics.name: Visual preference and aesthetic modeling
topics.summary: Preference models learn culturally sensitive rewards, disagreement-focused examples, and user clusters for aesthetic or visual-quality judgments. Their evaluations show that cohort structure and carefully chosen comparisons can improve personalization beyond a single global score.

topics.name: Tactile sensing and compliant robotic manipulation
topics.summary: Textile and soft actuators, compliant grippers, optical tactile fibers, force cues, and pose estimators provide contact information during manipulation. Perceptual tests and robot trials show benefits for grasp stability, shape estimation, and operation under disturbance.

topics.name: Robot navigation and collision avoidance
topics.summary: Navigation agents combine fresh visual observations, relational representations, geometric lookahead, learned policies, and explicit collision constraints. Simulation and transfer tests emphasize robustness to delay, appearance changes, moving obstacles, and multi-robot formation geometry.

topics.name: Compositional robot control and embodied agents
topics.summary: Composable robot controllers expose reusable skills, symbolic states, or priority rules so familiar behaviors can be recombined across tasks. Embodied-machine and multi-agent studies report better zero-shot sequencing and credit assignment when subtasks and interactions are represented explicitly.

topics.name: Robot manipulation learning and benchmarking
topics.summary: Manipulation benchmarks, imitation learners, offline policies, and reconfigurable hands focus data collection and control on contact-critical states. Structured dynamics and favorable terminal poses improve generalization in reach-avoid, assembly, and dexterous tasks.

topics.name: Robust and physics-informed robot control
topics.summary: Physics-aware policies and uncertainty-bounded controllers combine differentiable or approximate dynamics with barriers, stability maps, and conservative margins. Robot locomotion, flow navigation, and aerial systems retain safer behavior despite actuator and model mismatch.

topics.name: Autonomous vehicle trajectory planning
topics.summary: Trajectory planners for fixed-wing and marine vehicles use analytic or search-based warm starts followed by optimal-control refinement, while fault-tolerant rotor designs preserve lift after damage. Scenario-based wind and rule constraints produce feasible routes without relying on large historical datasets.

topics.name: Wireless sensing and localization
topics.summary: Wireless localization and sensing methods fuse maps, UWB anchors, terrain, propagation fields, and time-domain RF signatures. Cross-site transfer, automatic calibration, and compact convolutional models support positioning and drone detection under sparse or obstructed measurements.

topics.name: Traffic perception and intelligent transportation
topics.summary: Traffic research links route choice, stochastic flow, roadside camera-LiDAR calibration, and trajectory forecasting. Real-world studies across weather, lighting, and vulnerable-road-user settings target synchronized sensing and proactive intersection safety.

topics.name: Power-system forecasting and control
topics.summary: Grid studies cover load forecasting at multiple scales, adaptive residential demand, congestion mitigation, contingency assessment, and few-shot demand correction. Neural processes, transformers, reinforcement learning, and contextual bandits are evaluated against changing loads, limited labels, and noisy controls.

topics.name: Hydrometeorological hazard prediction
topics.summary: Radar sequence models and hazard-aware damage estimators combine kinematic features with exposure and vulnerability information. Minute-scale rainfall nowcasting and high-resolution flood mapping share an emphasis on rapid prediction that supports costly intervention decisions.

topics.name: Learning-based control for buildings and traffic
topics.summary: Learning-based controllers coordinate HVAC across generated buildings and traffic signals through hierarchical or language-model agents. Transfer tests under changing occupancy, demand, and dynamics connect control quality with energy use, emissions, and operational reliability.

topics.name: Physiological and biosignal recognition
topics.summary: ECG, EMG, remote photoplethysmography, EEG emotion signals, cardiometabolic records, activity sensors, and BCI measurements are modeled with domain priors, compact features, and multi-task calibration. Cross-subject or cross-population tests focus on generalization with limited channels and labels.

topics.name: Statistical inference, testing, and uncertainty
topics.summary: Certificates, exchangeability tools, changepoint tests, spatial-depth estimators, entropy methods, and uncertainty decompositions provide guarantees or diagnostics for limited and dependent data. Applications include synthetic-data fidelity, causal sampling, facial-age uncertainty, and online monitoring.

topics.name: Combinatorial optimization and adaptive search
topics.summary: Graph coloring, polynomial operators, matrix matching, contextual trading, bottleneck analysis, and budgeted constraint search use structured global exploration instead of one local trajectory. The recurring tradeoff is solution quality versus evaluation cost under discrete or noisy objectives.

topics.name: Continual learning
topics.summary: Replay selection, performative retraining, and quantum continual-learning analyses ask how updates preserve useful signals while the data or feedback process changes. Forward transfer and model-independent convergence improve when memory or regularization reflects task relationships.

topics.name: Efficient representation learning and model compression
topics.summary: Adaptive network widths, batch scheduling, attribution-based feature pruning, vector-quantization geometry, and Hebbian allocation direct capacity toward informative cases. Across restoration, time series, and compressed representations, matching difficulty and structure reduces cost while limiting collapse.

topics.name: Graph learning and relational structure
topics.summary: Federated multimodal graphs, industrial process graphs, hypergraph growth, gene-regulatory networks, optimal-transport matching, and knowledge-graph completion encode dependencies beyond flat features. Topology-aware learning improves alignment, anomaly detection, and relational inference while protecting or organizing distributed data.

topics.name: Graph learning for scientific structures
topics.summary: Protein conformations, phylogenies, and crystal environments are modeled with geometric or topological graph networks and interpretable neural readouts. The studies emphasize distance and property prediction, transfer across structures, and limitations from graph size or dimensional cost.

topics.name: Physics-informed scientific simulation
topics.summary: Physics-informed bases, variational solvers, LLM-assisted parameter search, Riemannian flow matching, neural ODEs, and generative ODE diagnostics reduce the cost of nonlinear scientific models. Domain constraints and error analysis are used to preserve stable behavior while improving calibration or sampling efficiency.

topics.name: Hybrid digital twins and learned simulation
topics.summary: Hybrid digital twins pair physical equations with learned components for machine-specific simulation and radar sensing. Surrogate accuracy is assessed through downstream control, reconstruction, or sim-to-real tasks where site adaptation is expensive.

topics.name: Statistical learning theory and optimization dynamics
topics.summary: Learning-theory papers study pseudo-label thresholds, stochastic-gradient scaling, domain partitions, and generalization under weakened assumptions. Their analyses connect flatness, data organization, and optimization dynamics to when empirical performance can be trusted.

topics.name: Multi-task representation learning
topics.summary: Shared representations are tested for interference, redundancy, temporal fusion, and low-rank task updates. Affective and general multi-task experiments favor clustered or task-aware sharing when a single universal feature space causes competition.

topics.name: Distributional behavior modeling
topics.summary: Population simulators and biologically motivated reinforcement-learning models represent stable individual differences rather than treating behavior variation as noise. Survey distributions and agent mechanisms are used to calibrate heterogeneity and explain non-modal choices.

topics.name: Social network and opinion dynamics
topics.summary: Temporal networks and opinion models simulate membership, communication, word-of-mouth, and community evolution. Their value lies in exposing how local exposure and changing group structure generate macroscopic social patterns.

topics.name: Cyber risk modeling and threat intelligence
topics.summary: Threat-intelligence systems combine CVE extraction, security ratings, model-access analysis, and structured applicability checks to prioritize cyber risk. The studies show that language-model automation can widen coverage, but hidden scoring behavior and uncertain evidence still require human review.

topics.name: Robust imbalanced tabular classification
topics.summary: Adversarial testing and synthetic-minority selection are paired with explanation-preserving training for rare-event tabular classification. Security and general binary benchmarks show better minority recall when perturbation sensitivity and feature-importance drift are monitored.

topics.name: Safety-critical machine learning evaluation
topics.summary: Privacy-preserving video transformations, fault-tolerant weight correction, and leakage-audited maintenance benchmarks examine whether reported safety gains survive realistic evaluation. Geometry preservation, provenance, and non-overlapping sequence splits are recurring safeguards against inflated results.

topics.name: Nonclassical hardware for machine learning
topics.summary: Thermodynamic circuits and quantum models explore probabilistic learning and forecasting outside conventional digital accelerators. Hardware-aware studies make noise, parameter count, fidelity, and implementation constraints part of the reported tradeoff.

topics.name: LLM inference, MoE serving, and hardware systems
topics.summary: LLM serving work spans prompt-cache economics, low-precision execution, compiler scheduling, expert routing, host-memory streaming, and looped sparse models. Production-style workloads measure cost, latency, current spikes, memory pressure, and reasoning quality together.

topics.name: Interactive visual analytics and authoring
topics.summary: Interactive visualization systems treat semantic chart elements, design steps, embeddings, rover episodes, and infographics as manipulable analytic objects. Dependency graphs, autocomplete, keyword steering, and user studies reduce authoring effort while preserving iterative human judgment.

topics.name: Constrained personalized planning
topics.summary: Itinerary and packing planners separate hard feasibility from learned preferences, then rank or locally adapt valid candidates. User comparisons and on-device settings show that constraint satisfaction and personalization can be improved together.

topics.name: Speech and audio modeling
topics.summary: Audio systems cover stem-effect prediction, voice-clone attribution, speech backdoor defense, string classification, Yoruba synthesis, cross-lingual speaker verification, and audio-video editing. Spectral features, phonological rules, trigger screening, and human-centered benchmarks address both recognition quality and misuse.
